subject: Service covenant redress and renewal option
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@strandbank.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@strandbank.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Service performance and renewal timeline

Hi Naomi / Jordan,

We're approaching the end of our annual contract and wanted to raise a concern before we get to renewal. Over the last six weeks we've seen three incidents where tail latency spiked and two brief regional availability blips that impacted our upstream authorization flows. The application teams logged customer-visible errors during peak windows and our ops team is asking for a more concrete commitment on availability and latency for next year.

Rather than push straight to churn, we want to explore an amendment that formalizes an uptime covenant and tighter latency SLOs for the production image-generation route. We have a renewal target of 2026-09-15; procurement asked me to surface this earlier so the legal and SRE squads can review.

Can you share what a premium SLA path would look like (target SLOs, credits, support model) and any requirement on reserved capacity or dedicated pools? We're open to a short call this week.

Thanks —
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Reliability
StrandBank

[Attachment: incident-timeline-202608.pdf]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@strandbank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@strandbank.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service performance and renewal timeline

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the timeline. I'm sorry you've had to deal with those disruptions. We take these incidents seriously.

Quick summary of options we can present:
- Premium SLA addendum: 99.95% monthly uptime, 95th/99th tail latency commitments scoped to the "prod-image" route; dedicated support queue with 1-hour P1 response and a named escalation engineer. Requires a small committed capacity uplift (dedicated instance pool) and a 12-month addendum.
- Resilience bundle: Same SLA but with automatic cross-region failover and proactive warm standby capacity during defined peak windows; higher commit but lower incident exposure.
- Credit structure: Standard credits apply for monthly SLO misses; for premium addendum we offer a capped credit ladder and a one-time service credit if two incidents occur within a rolling 30-day window.

I'm attaching a draft amendment and an SLO comparison matrix. Marcus will outline commercial terms; Rishi can provide the post-incident remediation plan.

Can we do a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow afternoon? If you prefer, we can prepare a tracked-redline contract for your legal team to expedite.

Best,
Naomi
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

[Attachments: redwood-amendment-draft-v1.docx, slo-comparison-matrix.xlsx]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@strandbank.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed commercial terms for premium addendum

Elena — following Naomi's note, here's an outline of the commercial approach we propose:

1) Commitment: 4 GPU-equivalent reserved units for the prod-image route (baseline uplift of 25% over current average).
2) Pricing: 18% uplift on hourly usage for reserved units, with credits capped at 30% of monthly commitment for repeated SLO misses.
3) Term: 12-month addendum with right to annual review; option to convert to Dedicated contract at renewal with a 60-day notice.
4) Onboarding: 2-week prioritized migration window with white-glove support and a runbook handoff.

We can bind these into the amendment Naomi attached. If procurement wants, we can provide a separate PO-ready statement of work.

Happy to discuss on the call.

Marcus
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@strandbank.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@strandbank.com>, Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@strandbank.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial terms for premium addendum

Thanks Marcus and Naomi — a few clarifying asks from SRE/legal/procurement:
- Can you give the exact definitions you'll use for "monthly uptime" and how regional incidents are accounted for? We need the math (uptime minutes and exclusion rules).
- For tail latency, we'll need percentiles and measurement windows (e.g., 95th over 30-day rolling using p95/p99 across 99% of requests, excluding scheduled maintenance).
- SOC 2 and incident evidence: legal requested SOC 2 report and the incident postmortem summary (redacted) for the most recent events.
- Doc timeline: we need the amendment in track-changes and a DocuSign-ready version for finance to process ahead of the 2026-09-15 renewal.

I'll book a 30-min slot for tomorrow 11:00 PT if that works.

Elena

On Mon, 31 Aug 2026 at 08:03 Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai> wrote:

>

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@strandbank.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial terms for premium addendum — remediation and evidence

Elena — following up on the SOC 2 and incident detail asks. Attached is a redacted post-incident summary for the August 12th event plus a link to our SOC 2 Type II certificate and control inventory. The postmortem includes timeline, root cause (packet loss during a rolling kernel update on a colo switch), customer impact estimation, and mitigations we implemented (config pinning for rolling updates, added health checks to the routing layer).

We can also provide a short-run dashboard export for the prod-image route showing p50/p95/p99 latency across the last 90 days; that will be part of the operations package if you choose the resilience bundle.

Let me know if redaction level is sufficient; happy to walk the SRE team through it on the call.

Rishi
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: postmortem-aug12-redacted.pdf]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@strandbank.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@strandbank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Final amendment and next steps (DocuSign link)

Elena / Carlos / Procurement — thanks for the productive call. Per the discussion we've updated the amendment with precise SLO language (monthly uptime measured in availability minutes, exclusions for scheduled maintenance with 48-hour notice, p95/p99 measurement windows defined over a 30-day rolling period). The draft includes:

- Premium SLA addendum with 99.95% uptime target and explicit latency percentiles for the prod-image route.
- Commitment to a named escalation engineer during incidents and a P1 1-hour response SLA.
- Credit ladder and capped monthly credit as discussed.
- Optional resilience bundle clauses (cross-region failover) as an appendix.

DocuSign link (ready): https://www.docusign.com/link/XXY-STRANDBANK-AMEND
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/DB-STR-2026-0819

If procurement signs by 2026-09-10 we can guarantee onboarding and warm standby before your renewal date. Please flag any last legal redlines — Marcus and I will respond within the day.

Best,
Naomi
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai
